services.name: Willamette Falls Private Tour
services.desc: Come sightseeing on the incredible Willamette River with us! Duration 2 Hours Description On tours cruising to the Willamette Falls, you will see Portland and Lake Oswego’s most beautiful homes, plenty of wildlife such as osprey, bald eagles, river otters, beavers, sea lions, and the majestic Willamette Falls in Oregon City! Regardless of the direction of travel, and no matter where we go, the Willamette River is full of natural beauty and wildlife! Cruising in either direction you will see some of Oregon’s beautiful nature in the city, historical landmarks, famous movie locations, and even some old movie props. services.name: Floating Homes Private Tour
services.desc: Come sightseeing on the incredible Willamette River with us! Duration 2 to 4 Hours Description We offer customizable half-day or full-day tours tailored to your preferences and special occasions! Portland and the surrounding areas have more than 3,500 unique Floating Homes. Through our partnership with floatinghomesforsale.com, we offer customized floating homes tours in the various moorages around the Portland area. Get a feel for life on the river and book a tour today! We look forward to having you as one of our river cruise guests!
